items.stem: Why do language AIs often sound so sure of themselves?

options.A: Fluent, confident wording is what they learned to produce in practice
options.B: They feel emotions the way people do
options.C: A human rewrites every answer before you see it

items.stem: When a language AI writes an answer, what is it mainly doing?

options.A: Reading your mind through the camera
options.B: Looking up one approved fact sheet for your company
options.C: Predicting the next likely chunk of text from patterns

items.stem: Does a language AI "know" things the way a colleague does?

options.A: Yes — it holds beliefs and can change its mind after reflection
options.B: No — it has no human-style knowledge or beliefs behind the words

items.stem: A smooth, confident sentence from an AI means:

options.A: The wording fits patterns of fluent text, not that every fact was checked
options.B: Every claim was verified against a trusted source
options.C: The AI is refusing to answer

items.stem: Why can an AI invent a wrong date while sounding certain?

options.A: It is choosing to lie to trick you
options.B: Someone typed the wrong date into your keyboard
options.C: It predicts likely wording even when the true fact is missing

items.stem: What should you do with an important claim an AI states confidently?

options.A: Paste it into a report with no changes
options.B: Check it before you rely on it or pass it on

items.stem: "The AI understands me like a person." What is the better view?

options.A: It matches patterns in wording; that is not human understanding
options.B: It has a private inner life and opinions
options.C: It only understands numbers, never words

items.stem: Where does the confident tone mostly come from?

options.A: A special "honesty dial" set to maximum
options.C: Practice on huge amounts of fluent text that sounds sure

items.stem: A teammate trusts any AI answer that "sounds professional." What do you say?

options.A: Professional tone always means the facts are safe
options.B: Tone is not evidence — important claims still need a check
options.C: Only casual answers can be wrong
